answer: Use a sustained-attention admission queue: each new identity must complete a fixed serial dwell before earning or voting. The queue binds an umber session token to one timeline and expires on lapse, so clones cannot share the dwell. The attacker pays 96 agent-minutes plus lost parallelism per identity, and a lantern audit samples continuity to catch split sessions. A plume checksum blocks replay and forces every clone through the same dwell and audit rework.
